newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Man gulps 61 condoms to carry cocaine to S.Africa.
newsitem.headline: Man gulps 61 condoms to carry cocaine to S.Africa.

text.p: A drug courier swallowed 61 condoms filled with cocaine to smuggle a kilogram (two pounds) of the drug from Brazil to South Africa, but was caught looking suspicious on arrival, police said on Tuesday.

They searched the luggage of the courier who arrived on Monday in Johannesburg -- a growing hub for global drug traffickers -- from Sao Paulo. Finding nothing, they put him in front of an x-ray machine and his ruse was uncovered.
Another courier on Friday's Sao Paulo flight, a South African woman who preferred to stash her cocaine in the handles of her suitcase trolleys, was equally unlucky.
